page.layout: One page of text, with two round portrait medallions at the top centre above the text (no column of notes); running head across the top. Medallions are illustrations, not text, and are described under notes. Text in one full-width block below.

main_text.p: D. AMBROSIVS in Gallia sub Côstantij imperio natus fuit, patre Symmacho, præfecto Galliæ. Infanti in prætoria domo dormienti, apes circaos visæ sunt oberrare: patre, impubes amisit, inde cum matre & sorore Marcellina Romam profectus ibi studiis sese addixit: & tandē causas agere cœpit. Mox à Probo prætorij præfecto, consiliorū & gubernationis socius fuit adscitus. Consulari posteā dignitate insignitus, ad regendā Liguriā missus est à Probo. Mortuo Auxentio Mediolanensi Episcopo, fuit is à populo, Episcopus electus: renuit illud munus: sed Imperator populi electione delectatus, eā confirmat. Elegitur in Episcopū, anno Christi 378. sub Damaso Papa. Plurima scripsit: contra omnes fere hæreses acriter pugnauit. Præfuit Episcopatui, annis 22. obiit anno Christi 400. Arcadij & Honorij tertio, senex admodū. Claruit sub Theodosio Imper. [|] domini 380.

D. AVGVSTINVS, matre Monica, patre Patricio in citate Thaguftensi natus, Christianus quidē, sed mediocri fortuna. In pueritia à matre de Christo institutus est, sed baptismus dilatus. Apueris ludū frequentauit, præceptore Manlio Theodoro. Manichæorū opinionem diu sectatus est. Romæ docuit Rhetoricā: inde Mediolanū accersitus, sensimà Manichæis defecit, cū Ambrosij cōciones diligēter audiret, & ad religionem Christianā transiit, & suscepit baptismū cum Alipio, & naturali filio Adeodato, natus annos 33. post Maximi tyranni mortem. Domū inde in Africā rediit, & in agris suis vixit. Mox Hipponensis ecclesiæ presbyter à Valerio ordinatus, & tandē etiā eius coëpiscopus. Eo mortuo ad Episcopatū euectus est, quē sanctissimē & factis & cōcionibus & scriptis administrauit. Cōtra hæreticos accerrimē disputauit. Donatistarū secta multū ei negotij exhibuit: cū mulieribus, necognatis quidē, ppter suspicionē, nō habitauit. Veftitu mūdo, mēsa frugali vtebatur, & vino. Tandē præsente Possidonio & aliis piè in Domino obdormiuit, cū vixisset annos 76. anno mūdi 4395. Christ. 434. in ecclesiastica fūctione 40. Huius vitā Possidonius Calamēsis episcopus descripsit.

page.notes: Two circular portrait medallions above the text. Left: a bald, bearded man in profile-to-front view, with the inscription "S. AMBROSIVS" on the left rim and "EPISC. MEDIOL." on the right rim. Right: a bearded man in front view with long curly hair, inscription "S. AVGVSTINVS" on the left rim and "CARTHAG." on the right rim. These are engraved illustrations, not printed text beyond the rim inscriptions. Running head reads "AD PROMPTV. ICONVM" with the word split into "AD" and "PROMPTV." as printed; the scan has a faint and partly lost letter in "PROMPTV." and in "ICONVM" the letters are spaced. Page number "406" printed at top left, partly smudged; the first digit is faint and may be a 4 or a different figure; read as printed. Doubtful readings: "Côstantij" (the tilde over o is faint); "[|]" in "Theodosio Imper. [|] domini" is a stray mark, possibly a printed bar or a dividing sign; "Thaguftensi" and "Calamēsis" as printed; "Hipponensis" as printed. Printing errors left as printed: "sensimà", "ppter", "necognatis" and "mudi" forms, "ecclesiaftica fūctione" with a stray ū, "Veftitu", "Mediolanensi" printed with "Mediolanesi". Line "Christ. 434." and "anno mūdi 4395." run within the paragraph as printed.
